svg.title: BLAST IGNITION startup storyboard: four illustrative 240 by 240 pixel panels
svg.desc: Static documentation illustration, not a device capture. Four panels read left to right, top to bottom: SYSTEM WAKE before motion, RHYTHM IGNITION at 60 milliseconds, BLAST ATTACK at 200 milliseconds, and MACHINE READY at 340 milliseconds. All native lettering uses the repository MD_F3 pixel glyphs at exact integer scales. The specified palette is quantized to RGB565 and expanded with the simulator color conversion. Grid bit zero is the leftmost column. The attack sample shows dim shards with no strike. These are still snapshots; the diagram specifies no blinking animation.
